## Repository protocol

- [ ] I did not weaken, skip, remove, or route around a validation check merely to make this PR pass.
- [ ] If `environment.yml` or `scripts/generate-lockfile.sh` changed, `conda-lock.yml` was regenerated and committed in this PR.
- [ ] If `environment-gpu.yml` or `scripts/generate-gpu-lockfile.sh` changed, `conda-lock-gpu.yml` was regenerated and committed in this PR.
- [ ] Generated lockfiles were not edited manually.
- [ ] Any CI/workflow permission or validation-policy change is called out explicitly in the PR description.
